correctness.rationale: Proof reconstructs automorphism group M⋊GL(V), squaring and shear-conjugation equations. In odd characteristic semisimple eigenspace arithmetic gives 3u²v+v³ and the conjugation map is surjective. In characteristic two, V decomposes into r projectives and s trivials; its triple tensor module has free multiplicity (n³-s³)/2 and trivial multiplicity s³, proving the quadratic kernel and quotient dimensions. Explicit elementary proofs cover r=0 and odd v=0,n. Actual packaged code checks all generator substitutions in n=2 q=2,3 and all linear involutions with explicit linear-algebra nullities n=3 q=2,3, plus field F4 n=2. No finite check is used as infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The rank-resolved involution counts and precise normal-quadratic-kernel conjugacy defect s^3 for the full truncated noncommutative tensor algebra in all finite characteristics do not follow from inspected nearby sources. This is a best-knowledge search assessment, not a proof of uniqueness. Full-text 2004 and 2013 associative invariant-theory literature concerns constant subalgebras, while the published GL2 tensor fixed-space census concerns arbitrary bilinear products and a different parameter and the cross algebra has different defining relations. General group cohomology is acknowledged as machinery rather than new theorem.
residual_risks: A stronger general published theorem on involutions in split affine groups or automorphism groups of radical-cube-zero free associative algebras might imply the explicit counts even without matching terminology.
The 2007 free-associative automorphism survey was checked at abstract level, not its entire full text; no global non-coverage is asserted from this limitation.
Normal-quadratic-subgroup orbit counts do not determine full automorphism-group conjugacy classes.
This self-review does not constitute an external or independent literature verification.

value.rationale: The minimal nontrivial truncated free associative algebra has a natural deformation problem: which non-linear order-two automorphisms lift a prescribed linear involution, and when can quadratic corrections be removed by a tangent-to-identity change of generators? The complete rank-by-rank counts answer this naturally occurring invariant, while the characteristic-two cubic residual (n-2r)^3 identifies a sharp conjugacy obstruction absent in odd characteristic. The rank >=3 result is a uniform structural and enumerative theorem, not a tiny arithmetic gain or a renaming of a fixed-tensor table.
